draft.subject: A quick next step for Vantage Logistics
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Nice work getting your first project created last week — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them.

The other step that tends to make things click is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how your team's work is best structured in Wrenfield and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
